en.title: Verba — Voice Translator
en.subtitle: Translate, talk & learn
en.short_description: Translate typed or spoken phrases, practise speaking, and study phrases that stick.
en.description:
Verba is a translator you can talk to, and a way to keep what you learn.

—— Translate ——

TRANSLATE
Type a phrase and get it back in the language you need, in 12 languages.

VOICE
Tap the mic, say a phrase, and Verba translates it when you finish speaking.

CONVERSATION
Two people take turns: each speaks in their own language and the other side shows the translation.

—— Learn ——

PRACTICE
Say real phrases for situations like the airport, a restaurant or a hotel, and see which words the speech recogniser heard.

FLASHCARDS
Spanish, French and Mandarin phrase decks with spaced repetition: each card comes back when it is due, and your review dates are kept on your phone.

PHRASEBOOK
Save any translation with one tap and find it again in your phrasebook.

—— Built to be used ——

• Text-to-speech, so you hear how it should sound
• Material 3 interface with glassmorphic cards
• Notification reminders for your streak and practice, using inexact alarms
• The microphone is optional: typing works without it
• No account needed to start

—— Ads ——

Verba is free and may show ads through Google AdMob. There are no in-app purchases and no paid tier.

—— About translation quality ——

Translation and speech recognition are automated and imperfect, especially with accents, background noise, idiom and specialist vocabulary. Do not rely on Verba for medical, legal, financial, safety or immigration matters — use a qualified human interpreter.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Verba is a translator you can talk to, and a way to keep what you learn.

Intended audience:
Translate, talk & learn

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch: Translate (Text, Voice and Convo modes), Practice (Practice > Phrasebook & Flashcards for the decks and saved translations) and Me (settings, Privacy Policy and Terms of Service). The microphone and notification permissions are optional; onboarding can be finished without granting either, and typed translation works without the microphone.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Crashlytics (Google) — crash reporting
- Firebase Analytics (Google) — usage analytics
- Google AdMob — advertising
- MyMemory (Translated srl) — text translation; text entered in Translate is sent to api.mymemory.translated.net

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
None. Features and content are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.

differentiation:
1. WHAT IT DOES
Verba is a translator you can talk to, and a way to keep what you learn from the conversation.
Screens it contains: home, legal, me, onboarding, practice, splash, translate (the Talk and Buddy screens exist in the code but are hidden in this build because they need an on-device language model the build does not ship)

2. INTENDED USER
People who need to communicate in a language they do not speak, typically travellers at an airport, restaurant or hotel: they type or speak a phrase and get it translated in one of 12 languages, or hold a two-way conversation where each person speaks their own language. It is also for learners of Spanish, French or Mandarin, who practise phrases and review flashcard decks with spaced repetition. The app states that it is not suitable for medical, legal, financial, safety or immigration matters.

Both numbers exclude the ~60 widgets every Flutter app uses — Column, Text,

6. COULD THIS BE AN IN-APP PURCHASE IN ANOTHER APP
No. No other app on this account is in its category (EDUCATION), so there is no existing app it could be an in-app purchase or feature of.

7. CODE SHARED WITH OUR OTHER APPS
Yes, infrastructure only: agl_ads (ad mediation); agl_observability (crash reporting). It has no sign-in and does not use Supabase. No screens, features or content are shared; the similarity figure in 5 measures exactly that.

8. CODE SHARED WITH THIRD-PARTY APPS
No, beyond standard third-party frameworks: firebase_analytics, firebase_core, firebase_crashlytics, firebase_messaging, firebase_performance, flutter_animate, flutter_local_notifications, flutter_localizations, flutter_riverpod, flutter_tts.
